methods: Trace one hypothesis through the source, checker and complete caller.

original_card.acceptance_gate: Pin the current sources and one obligation; the historical owner audit is an example, not evidence of a current bug.

original_card.first_experiment: Choose one current supplier obligation and trace whether its acceptance depends on an independent check.
original_card.bottleneck_link: Closing a current acceptance gap or proof obligation strengthens reliability even without changing kappa.
allowed_variations: Audit one named current condition using a new semantic counterexample.
scope_change_triggers: Reporting the historical timing-only diagnostic as a new current acceptance bug.

actual_scope: Adversarial audit of the increment of pending T74 claim PR #2802 (head 17b2ee6e) over its parent PR #2751 (head 4cfbb0cc): the seven declared stages refit5/alias5/refit5c/refit7/hostmove2/alias7/refit7c (seven retired-lender aliases, two hostee moves, refits) and the FILL2751->FILL transform, checked with fresh exact code on both words: event diff, per-register occupancy timeline, forward/dual free-algebra replay plus a matrix realisation, GF(2) warp frames and refit exactness, profile/inventory recount by two subspace representations, the 271,728-role fill with word-derived R, complete profile/mass/root; the verdict is extended to PR #2818 (head 175822ae), whose words/fill/order/providers are byte-identical.
scope_change_reason: The card asks whether one selected-supplier obligation follows from its source-bound checks. The selected supplier is unchanged, while the top pending T74 claim (#2802, repackaged by #2818) changed two acceptance checks (R read from the providers; the A-retired-lender alias control) and its new construction had no independent check; the maintainer's T74 reviews ask to separate the new construction from inherited ancestors.
bottleneck_link: A defect would remove the +5.38e-7 kappa margin of #2802/#2818 over #2766/#2767; a pass is necessary but not sufficient (inherited T74/#1319 admission, native lowering and the PR1673 outer proof remain). It also identifies which check protects alias occupancy: the scalar replays do not.
stop_rule: Publish an independent verification if S1, S2 and S5 pass, S3/S4/S6 agree and every negative control is rejected by its named rule; on any mismatch minimise a witness, post a FINDING in #2612 and ship a negative result without repair. No search; #2751's twelve-source recovery treated as a pinned parent.
evidence: verify.py --fetch: PASS_T74_RETIRED7_INCREMENT_AUDIT rules=26/26 controls=15/15 (about 80 s). Both words: 63 relabelled B gates = 63 declared edit pairs; 62 frame changes = 62 declared refit frames; nothing else changed; 704 register segments each exactly one parent role (lenders 401/403 last act at A3175/A3174 before warps at B259/B262; 550-553/562 at B901-B910; 564/565 at B911/B912 before B941/B944); forward+dual replay over Q<free group> on 632 live inputs with 72 zero buffers and the re-derived 4547-item cleanup; 4x4 matrix realisation mod 2^61-1; 72+24 warps with G(U)=E and U the propagated frame; profile {1:2382,2:648,3:268,4:128,5:26,8:8}, inventory {4:26,5:2,7:62,8:78,9:240}; fill R=408 from the words, 271728 roles, idle {1:17316,3:6594,5:9878,32:1,48:26558}, FILL = FILL2751 minus 4662 roles; complete profile and mass 4816512; f(C) < 66304 < f(C+1e-24). Own stage-by-stage rebuild reproduces W2802 exactly; attribution: the 20 PR2766-credited frames give PR2766's claimed profile, reconstructed retired5 brackets its root at 0.001717409316335491643448, and the new retired7 part adds 385667783143020379/10^24 over retired5. Controls C4a/C4b (lender gate moved past its alias warp) are accepted by both scalar replays and rejected only by frame monotonicity and the occupancy timeline. #2818 identical.
